spec: x402 delivery-receipt, draft v0.2.1 — PROPOSED negative vectors (not part of the specification)
signedWith: the published test seeds endToEnd.seeds.receiptKeys (0202…×32) for both algorithms; ML-DSA-65 signatures are hedged (openssl 3.6), so verify, do not re-sign
readingNote: Levels after the first failing level are reported as not-evaluated by the generator's verifier. A verifier that evaluates every level independently may report pass on a later level; valid, reason.level and longTermEvidence are the same either way (§8.1).
refNote: Shared inputs are $ref pointers into delivery-receipt.vectors.json (/endToEnd/…), as they would be if these fixtures were merged into that file; the runner overlays this file onto it.

keyDirectoryDigestMismatch.description: endToEnd payload with keyDirectoryDigest replaced by another 64-hex value and re-signed with the published receipt seeds. The epoch resolves and the signatures verify; §7.5 step 2 fails: the receipt is not trusted.

amountInflatedResigned.description: endToEnd payload with amount 10000 → 10000000, re-signed with the published receipt seeds. Everything a third party can check passes (integrity, authentic, trusted); only the client's own observation (SettleResponse / accepted requirements, §8.3) catches it. This is the §12 boundary: a receipt is the issuer's admission, not an independent witness of the amount.

mlDsa65Stripped.description: endToEnd receipt with the ml-dsa-65 entry removed. §6.1: a receipt that lacks either baseline signature is malformed (integrity fails) on every path, including the session path that would not have checked it.

splitVerdict.description: endToEnd payload re-signed; the ml-dsa-65 signature has one byte flipped, the ed25519 signature is valid. §6.1: the archival path verifies every entry and fails; the session path passes and MUST report ml-dsa-65 as not checked. A result from the session path is not long-term evidence.

issuedInFuture.description: endToEnd payload with issuedAt = now + 3600 (beyond the default 300 s allowance of §7.4), re-signed. Integrity and the signatures pass; trusted fails.

framingUnregistered.description: endToEnd/stream with delivery.framing = "ndjson" (not registered by v0.2.1), receipt inline in the terminal event, re-signed. §5.6: a verifier MUST reject (integrity) a stream receipt whose framing is not registered, before any digest is compared.

eventAfterTerminal.description: endToEnd/stream event stream with one more data event appended after the terminal event. The receipt is the original; the digest over the first three frames still matches. §5.6: events after the terminal event are not covered and their presence is a delivery failure.
